content:
Main Character:  Kaoru @[image1] @[image2] (keep facial features consistent and the exact same visual style)Location: Hallway outside Kaoru’s tattoo studio.Other character: Middle-aged neighbor who regularly tells him too much.
 
Shot 1 — 0:00–0:02Neighbor corners Kaoru in the hallway.NEIGHBOR: “You remember what I told you Tuesday?”
Shot 2 — 0:02–0:03.5Kaoru immediately nods.KAORU: “Unfortunately.”
Shot 3 — 0:03.5–0:05.5Neighbor leans closer.NEIGHBOR: “You didn’t tell anyone?”
Shot 4 — 0:05.5–0:07Kaoru looks mildly offended.KAORU: “I’m a professional.”
Shot 5 — 0:07–0:09Neighbor relaxes.
Shot 6 — 0:09–0:11Kaoru adds calmly:KAORU: “Also nobody would believe me.”
Shot 7 — 0:11–0:13Neighbor’s eyes widen.NEIGHBOR: “What does that mean?”
Shot 8 — 0:13–0:15Kaoru walks past with a tiny smile.KAORU: “See you Tuesday.”Neighbor watches him leave, horrified.

Personnage principal : Kaoru @[image1] @[image2] (conserver des traits du visage cohérents et exactement le même style visuel)  
Lieu : Couloir à l’extérieur du studio de tatouage de Kaoru.  
Autre personnage : Voisin d’âge mûr qui lui en dit régulièrement trop.
 
Plan 1 — 0:00–0:02  
Le voisin accule Kaoru dans le couloir.  
VOISIN : « Tu te souviens de ce que je t’ai dit mardi ? »

Plan 2 — 0:02–0:03.5  
Kaoru hoche immédiatement la tête.  
KAORU : « Malheureusement. »

Plan 3 — 0:03.5–0:05.5  
Le voisin se penche plus près.  
VOISIN : « Tu n’en as parlé à personne ? »

Plan 4 — 0:05.5–0:07  
Kaoru prend un air légèrement offensé.  
KAORU : « Je suis un professionnel. »

Plan 5 — 0:07–0:09  
Le voisin se détend.

Plan 6 — 0:09–0:11  
Kaoru ajoute calmement :  
KAORU : « De toute façon, personne ne me croirait. »

Plan 7 — 0:11–0:13  
Les yeux du voisin s’écarquillent.  
VOISIN : « Qu’est-ce que ça veut dire ? »

Plan 8 — 0:13–0:15  
Kaoru passe devant lui avec un léger sourire.  
KAORU : « À mardi. »  
Le voisin le regarde s’éloigner, horrifié.

ko.content:
주인공: Kaoru @[image1] @[image2] (얼굴 특징은 일관되게 유지하고, 시각적 스타일은 완전히 동일하게 유지)  
장소: Kaoru의 타투 스튜디오 바깥 복도.  
다른 인물: 자주 너무 많은 이야기를 털어놓는 중년 이웃.

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:02  
이웃이 복도에서 Kaoru를 몰아세운다.  
NEIGHBOR: “화요일에 내가 말한 거 기억나?”

Shot 2 — 0:02–0:03.5  
Kaoru가 즉시 고개를 끄덕인다.  
KAORU: “유감스럽게도.”

Shot 3 — 0:03.5–0:05.5  
이웃이 더 가까이 몸을 기울인다.  
NEIGHBOR: “아무한테도 말 안 했지?”

Shot 4 — 0:05.5–0:07  
Kaoru가 약간 기분 상한 표정을 짓는다.  
KAORU: “전 프로예요.”

Shot 5 — 0:07–0:09  
이웃이 긴장을 푼다.

Shot 6 — 0:09–0:11  
Kaoru가 차분하게 덧붙인다:  
KAORU: “게다가 아무도 저를 믿지 않을 거예요.”

Shot 7 — 0:11–0:13  
이웃의 눈이 커진다.  
NEIGHBOR: “그게 무슨 뜻이야?”

Shot 8 — 0:13–0:15  
Kaoru가 작은 미소를 지으며 지나간다.  
KAORU: “화요일에 봐요.”  
이웃은 그가 떠나는 모습을 공포에 질린 채 바라본다.

Personagem principal: Kaoru @[image1] @[image2] (mantenha os traços faciais consistentes e exatamente o mesmo estilo visual)  
Local: Corredor do lado de fora do estúdio de tatuagem de Kaoru.  
Outro personagem: Vizinho de meia-idade que vive contando coisas demais para ele.
 
Cena 1 — 0:00–0:02  
O vizinho encurrala Kaoru no corredor.  
VIZINHO: “Você lembra do que eu te contei na terça?”
Cena 2 — 0:02–0:03.5  
Kaoru imediatamente acena com a cabeça.  
KAORU: “Infelizmente.”
Cena 3 — 0:03.5–0:05.5

VIZINHO: “Você não contou pra ninguém?”
Cena 4 — 0:05.5–0:07  
Kaoru parece levemente ofendido.  
KAORU: “Eu sou um profissional.”
Cena 5 — 0:07–0:09  
O vizinho relaxa.
Cena 6 — 0:09–0:11  
Kaoru acrescenta calmamente:  
KAORU: “Além disso, ninguém acreditaria em mim.”
Cena 7 — 0:11–0:13  
Os olhos do vizinho se arregalam.  
VIZINHO: “O que isso quer dizer?”
Cena 8 — 0:13–0:15  
Kaoru passa por ele com um sorrisinho.  
KAORU: “Até terça.”  
O vizinho o observa ir embora, horrorizado.

zh.content:
主角：Kaoru @[image1] @[image2]（保持面部特征一致，且视觉风格完全相同）  
地点：Kaoru 纹身工作室外的走廊。  
其他角色：一位经常对他讲太多的中年邻居。
 
镜头 1 — 0:00–0:02  
邻居在走廊里把 Kaoru 逼到角落。  
NEIGHBOR: “你还记得我星期二跟你说的事吗？”
镜头 2 — 0:02–0:03.5  
Kaoru 立刻点头。  
KAORU: “很不幸，记得。”
镜头 3 — 0:03.5–0:05.5  
邻居凑得更近。  
NEIGHBOR: “你没告诉别人吧？”
镜头 4 — 0:05.5–0:07  
Kaoru 露出一点被冒犯的表情。  
KAORU: “我是专业的。”
镜头 5 — 0:07–0:09  
邻居放松下来。
镜头 6 — 0:09–0:11  
Kaoru 平静地补充道：  
KAORU: “而且也没人会相信我。”
镜头 7 — 0:11–0:13  
邻居瞪大眼睛。  
NEIGHBOR: “那是什么意思？”
镜头 8 — 0:13–0:15  
Kaoru 带着一丝微笑从他身边走过。  
KAORU: “星期二见。”  
邻居惊恐地看着他离开。
